verdict.rationale: The pack shows royalty terms changed over time (5% of gross → 5% after $3,000/quarter) but no evidence addresses whether such changes were ever applied retroactively to already-shipped titles or whether Epic has an explicit no-retroactive-repricing policy/track record. Missing for 10: documented policy or community confirmation that license terms are grandfathered for shipped games, evidence of any past retroactive-change controversy or its resolution.
